detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Notice: Co-op is currently in development for this game and is expected to be released as a free update sometime after launch.

A giant toy store. 2,694 toys out of place. One mission: put everything back where it belongs.

In Toy Keeper, you'll explore a colorful three-story toy store filled with dinosaurs, robots, dolls, vehicles, blocks, plushies, and more. Pick up toys, sort them into their correct sections, and transform a mountain of chaos into a perfectly organized store.

Earn coins as you clean and spend them on the Ball Machine, where every ball grants a new upgrade to help you organize faster and more efficiently.

A Mountain of Toys to Master

Thousands of tiny items, one very determined manager. Build order from toy-store chaos and keep every shelf under control.

Unlock Powerful Perks

Choose upgrades like helper bots to automate the busywork and keep the store moving while you focus on bigger goals.

Organize Everything

Sort, place, and tidy every corner until the whole shop runs like a perfect little machine.

Take Care of Your Baby

Your smallest helper needs attention too. Keep the baby happy while the store gets busier around you.

Three Floors of Tiny Chaos

Move fast across multiple floors, discover new areas, and turn every level into a perfectly managed toy empire.

Unlock Powerful Upgrades

Build your own playstyle with dozens of perks and abilities:

  • Sprint faster

  • Throw objects

  • Highlight nearby toys

  • Attract distant objects

  • Coin magnet

  • Object magnet

  • Double, Triple, Quadruple, Quintuple, and Sextuple Jump

  • Jetpack

  • Wings

  • Direction beacon showing where items belong

  • Storage boxes for transporting multiple toys

  • Place multiple nearby objects at once

  • Helper robots that organize toys for you

  • Movement speed multipliers

  • And many more surprises

A Playful Companion

You're not alone.

A curious baby accompanies you throughout the store, playing with toys, wandering around, and occasionally creating a little extra mess for you to deal with. Sometimes helpful, sometimes distracting, always adorable.

Relaxing Chaos

Take your time, optimize your routes, unlock upgrades, and watch the store slowly transform from complete disorder into a perfectly organized toy paradise.

Can you place all 2,694 toys back where they belong?
